meta.product: Commercial & Residential Smart-Glass Maintenance and Retrofit Packages
meta.market: Commercial real estate facilities management, commercial property operations, luxury residential development
meta.revenue_model: B2B productized service with maintenance subscription

decision_frame.decision_statement: Determine whether ClearGlassInc should prioritize facility managers and commercial-real-estate operators over luxury residential developers for the initial 90-day go-to-market cycle.
decision_frame.decision_owner: SIR, Software Architect / COO / Technology Strategist, ClearGlassInc
decision_frame.success_metric: Qualified sales opportunities that meet the ideal-customer profile and progress to a discovery call
decision_frame.target_threshold: To be defined after baseline establishment; do not assume a target
exclusions: No outreach to consumers without an approved residential offer
No paid advertising until unit economics and compliance review pass
No CRM writes without human approval
No public pricing commitments without human approval
No claims of energy savings, ROI, or performance without substantiation
kill_criteria: CAC exceeds $1,200 without a credible path to improvement
Gross margin remains below 65% after fulfillment and acquisition costs
Payback period exceeds 3 months after a valid cohort measurement
No repeatable qualified-opportunity source emerges after the test period
Compliance, consent, or platform-policy blocker cannot be resolved

executive_brief.bottom_line: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE: ClearGlassInc should not yet commit to a primary segment, channel mix, or scaling decision.
executive_brief.recommended_decision: Run a 90-day, budget-capped validation program across facility managers, commercial-real-estate operators, and luxury residential developers; establish baselines before prioritization.
executive_brief.why_now: The supplied parameters define the commercial thesis, but do not yet establish demand evidence, competitor positioning, channel economics, fulfillment capacity, or baseline conversion performance.
executive_brief.expected_impact: UNKNOWN — requires baseline demand, conversion, fulfillment-cost, and channel-cost data
executive_brief.downside_if_wrong: Misallocating the $3,000 monthly budget, damaging sender reputation through premature outreach, or committing to a price that cannot sustain the 65% gross-margin target.
executive_brief.what_would_change_this_recommendation: Verified demand signals, at least two credible sources for segment prioritization, validated unit economics, and a successful pilot meeting its predefined conversion and CAC thresholds.
executive_brief.next_checkpoint: Weekly review; formal decision review on 2026-12-06

market_state.market_definition: Commercial and residential building owners, operators, facility managers, and developers seeking smart-glass maintenance, seal remediation, retrofit, or performance-improvement services.

limitations: No verified pricing, conversion, retention, or fulfillment-cost baseline

segments.segment: Commercial facility managers and real-estate operations leaders
segments.hypothesis: High HVAC load, tenant comfort complaints, energy-cost pressure, and glass seal degradation create recurring maintenance and retrofit demand.

segments.segment: Commercial property owners and asset managers
segments.hypothesis: Asset-preservation, tenant experience, operating-cost reduction, and capital-planning needs create retrofit demand.

segments.segment: Luxury residential developers and high-end property managers
segments.hypothesis: Premium glazing performance, aesthetics, privacy, and maintenance expectations create a differentiated service opportunity.

strategic_options.thesis: Prioritize VP Facilities and Director of Real Estate Operations contacts at mid-to-large commercial properties, using an operations-and-cost diagnostic as the initial offer.
strategic_options.downside_if_wrong: Facilities contacts may lack budget authority or may require an asset-management sponsor before purchase.
kill_criteria: No qualified opportunities after the predefined test volume
strategic_options.next_action: Approve research plan and define qualified-opportunity criteria

strategic_options.thesis: Prioritize commercial property owners and asset managers through capital-planning and asset-preservation messaging.
strategic_options.downside_if_wrong: Longer sales cycles and higher requirement for proof, references, and financial modeling.
kill_criteria: No qualified opportunities after the predefined test volume
Sales cycle exceeds the 90-day decision horizon without a credible path
strategic_options.next_action: Approve research plan and define qualified-opportunity criteria

strategic_options.thesis: Prioritize luxury residential developers and premium property managers with a maintenance-and-retrofit package.
strategic_options.downside_if_wrong: Project-based demand may be episodic and less compatible with a recurring $450-per-month maintenance model.
kill_criteria: No repeatable recurring-revenue conversion after the predefined test volume
strategic_options.next_action: Approve research plan and define qualified-opportunity criteria

red_team.strongest_counterargument: The proposed buyer may not be the economic buyer; facility managers may identify the problem, while ownership, asset management, or development leadership controls capital approval.
alternative_explanations: Demand may be project-based rather than subscription-based
The $450 monthly maintenance price may not match buyer willingness to pay
The $2,500 setup price may be too low or too high depending on scope and geography
HVAC-load reduction may not be a credible or measurable outcome without an engineering methodology
bias_risks: Confirmation bias toward the existing offer
Survivorship bias from selecting only visible competitors
Recency bias from over-weighting recent online signals
Selection bias from relying on outbound-response data alone
falsification_tests: Test whether target buyers recognize the problem and express willingness to evaluate a paid diagnostic or assessment
Test whether the proposed recurring price survives a structured pricing conversation
Test whether fulfillment cost supports a 65% gross margin
Test whether a low-cost channel produces qualified opportunities below the $1,200 CAC ceiling
minimum_evidence_needed: At least two independent sources per high-impact market claim
A defined ideal-customer profile and disqualification criteria
A baseline conversion rate and CAC by channel
A fulfillment-cost model including labor, travel, materials, subcontractors, warranty reserve, and overhead allocation
A compliance review of outreach, privacy, claims, and platform policies
red_team.decision_risk_if_wrong: Wasted budget, damaged domain reputation, non-compliant outreach, unprofitable pricing, and inability to fulfill demand at the promised standard.

evidence_ledger.claim: Facility managers and commercial-real-estate operators experience high HVAC load or glass seal degradation that creates demand for smart-glass maintenance and retrofit services.
The $2,500 setup plus $450 monthly per-property price can achieve a 65% gross margin.
LinkedIn outbound, B2B email, SEO, and commercial-real-estate communities can acquire customers at or below a $1,200 CAC.

proposed_actions.action: Create a research and validation plan
proposed_actions.draft_content: Approve a 90-day, budget-capped validation program across facilities, asset-owner, and luxury-residential segments before committing to a primary segment or channel.
proposed_actions.rollback_plan: No external effect; discard research plan if rejected.

Verified competitor pricing, positioning, and service scope
Verified fulfillment cost per property and per service visit
Verified channel acquisition cost and conversion rate
Verified legal basis and consent process for B2B email outreach in the U.S. and Canada
Verified claims substantiation for any energy, HVAC, comfort, or cost-savings benefit
Verified service capacity, geographic coverage, warranty exposure, and subcontractor availability
open_questions: Which segment has the clearest budget authority and shortest path to a paid pilot?
What measurable outcome can ClearGlass substantiate without overclaiming performance?
What is the actual fully loaded fulfillment cost per property and per maintenance visit?
Which channel can generate qualified opportunities below the $1,200 CAC ceiling?
What proof, case study, or diagnostic offer is needed before a prospect will engage?
